annotations.title: No tax on tips or overtime

description: Compute the 2025 law's federal deduction for qualified tips or qualified overtime pay (2025 to 2028): the deduction after the yearly cap and the income phase-out, eligibility (for example married filing separately does not qualify) and the federal income tax it saves. For overtime, give the overtime premium, or hours and the regular rate. Returns figures, official sources and the tax year used.

amount.description: tips: qualified tips received for the year. overtime: the overtime premium (the extra half of time-and-a-half), if known, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately) or hoh (head of household). Default single.

kind.description: tips: the qualified tips deduction. overtime: the qualified overtime compensation deduction (the half-time premium only).

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income for the year (for most people, AGI), in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

overtime_hours.description: overtime only, instead of amount: hours paid at time-and-a-half in the year

regular_rate.description: overtime only, with overtime_hours: the regular hourly rate in dollars

tax_year.description: The tax year the figures are for (2025, 2026, 2027). Leave it out for the default: last year's return until April 15, then the current year.

name: tips_overtime_deduction
